entities.name: Gitrog Monster
entities.description: An enormous frog living in the depths of Lake Zhava on Innistrad, worshipped by a cult; it later carries Thalia against Phyrexians.

entities.name: Lake Zhava
entities.description: Lake in the highlands of Nephalia on Innistrad where the Gitrog lives.

entities.name: Nephalia
entities.description: Region of Innistrad containing Lake Zhava.

entities.name: Gavony
entities.description: Region of Innistrad near the Gitrog's lake.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: Eldrazi titan whose influence severely mutated the Gitrog.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Invaders whose strange machines came to the Gitrog's lake and who besieged Thalia.

entities.name: Thraben
entities.description: City on Innistrad where the Gitrog finds Thalia.

entities.name: Thalia
entities.description: Last survivor of her Cathar squad, rescued by and riding the Gitrog Monster.

entities.name: Thunder Junction
entities.description: Plane the Gitrog reached via an Omenpath.

entities.name: Omenpath
entities.description: Transplanar pathway through which the Gitrog reached Thunder Junction.

events.summary: Villagers near the lake begin sacrificing sheep, and later humans, to the Gitrog as madness grows.
events.quote: They began to sacrifice sheep to the Gitrog, and later humans

events.summary: Strange machines come to the Gitrog's lake and try to hurt it, so it leaves the water.
events.quote: the Gitrog Monster heaved itself out of the waters and headed straight for Thraben

events.summary: The Gitrog Monster rescues Thalia from Phyrexians at Thraben and lets her ride it.
events.quote: the Gitrog Monster bowled through her besiegers, saving her

events.summary: The Gitrog arrives on Thunder Junction through an Omenpath.
events.quote: The Gitrog found its way onto Thunder Junction through an Omenpath

relations.note: Saves her and carries her into battle.
relations.quote: Seeing the potential for a new human to bring it food, the Gitrog Monster bowled through her besiegers, saving her.
the monster was severely mutated by the Eldrazi titan's influence
The Gitrog monster is an enormous frog that lives in the depths of Lake Zhava
